mechanism_narrative: A lower level of the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) compresses the discount rate for equity valuation, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days through continuous monetary easing effects.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC for FEDFUNDS predicting 20-day SPX returns is below 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in the unemployment rate above 4.0% signals deteriorating labor market conditions that depress corporate earnings growth, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when UNRATE rises above 4.0%.

mechanism_narrative: The interaction between declining FEDFUNDS and rising UNRATE indicates a dovish policy response to labor market weakness, creating recessionary risk that drives negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The interaction term (FEDFUNDS * UNRATE) has a Rank IC below 0.05 for predicting 20-day SPX returns over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: High housing starts (HOUST > 1300.0) in a late-cycle expansion regime signal overvaluation and impending monetary tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when HOUST > 1300.0.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production below 108.0 signals manufacturing contraction that reduces corporate revenue visibility, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when INDPRO falls below 108.0.

mechanism_narrative: The interaction between strong housing starts (HOUST) and robust retail sales (RSAFS) indicates sustained consumer demand that accelerates corporate earnings growth, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The interaction term (HOUST * RSAFS) has a Rank IC below 0.05 for predicting 20-day SPX returns over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in non-farm payrolls below 150,000 signals labor market deterioration that reduces consumer spending confidence, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when PAYEMS falls below 150000.0.

mechanism_narrative: In a monetary tightening cycle (FEDFUNDS > 2.5%), rising interest rates compress equity valuations through higher discount rates, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when FEDFUNDS rises above 2.5%.
